##### Project general facts

Time 2 is an exclusive residential development by Time Properties, offering a collection of studios and one, two, and three-bedroom apartments. This contemporary residential tower features a basement, ground level, podium levels, and residential floors, combining traditional ideas with modern luxury to create spacious functions where residents can enjoy a comfortable lifestyle. The architectural genius comes to your doorstep with the class of luxury and brilliant methods of lifestyle enhancements, offering bespoke luxury crafted with attention to every minute detail.
 
With world-class amenities and everything you could possibly need just footsteps away, Time 2 is located in a prime position at the center of a comprehensive community. Residents enjoy the very best health, education, and recreational facilities, along with a variety of dining, retail, business, and leisure destinations. The safe and secure residential building ensures peace of mind, while the thoughtfully designed spaces provide comfort, convenience, and connectivity in homes that exude elegance.

Every residence at Time 2 features bespoke luxury crafted with attention to every minute detail, from customized wardrobes to the marble and glass dynamics of the homes. The interiors are designed with contemporary living in mind, offering stylish homes ideal for those who seek a balanced lifestyle. From leisure-loving families and activity-seeking couples to career-driven professionals, each home reflects a commitment to quality and design excellence.  

##### Location description and benefits

Nestled in Dubailand, one of the most successful projects by master developer Dubai Properties, this exceptional location offers a comprehensive community with many different facilities, from theme parks and shopping malls to eco-tourism projects and residential communities. Popular among residents and investors mainly due to affordable rents and the range of freehold properties available, the area provides everything residents could possibly need.

The location is distinguished by its strategic positioning and excellent connectivity. The Aquila School, Skycourts Towers, Zayed University, UAE Academic City, Dubai Silicon Oasis, Liwan, and Dubai Outlet Mall are all within easy reach. Major road networks including Dubai-Al Ain Road, Emirates Road, and Sheikh Zayed Bin Hamdan Al Nahyan Street provide seamless connectivity to key destinations across Dubai. 

For those seeking a residence that embodies comfort, convenience, and a prime Dubai address, Dubailand delivers an unmatched lifestyle. Its unique combination of world-class amenities, strategic connectivity, and a prestigious location makes it one of Dubai's most desirable destinations. This is a place where one can enjoy the best of city living.
